comment:
* Encapsulates information parsed from a track encryption (tenc) box or sample group description
 * (sgpd) box in an MP4 stream.

variables.name: isEncrypted
variables.comment: Indicates the encryption state of the samples in the sample group.

variables.name: schemeType
variables.comment: The protection scheme type, as defined by the 'schm' box, or null if unknown.

variables.name: cryptoData
variables.comment:
* A {@link TrackOutput.CryptoData} instance containing the encryption information from this
   * {@link TrackEncryptionBox}.

variables.name: perSampleIvSize
variables.comment: The initialization vector size in bytes for the samples in the corresponding sample group.

variables.name: defaultInitializationVector
variables.comment:
* If {@link #perSampleIvSize} is 0, holds the default initialization vector as defined in the
   * track encryption box or sample group description box. Null otherwise.

methods.name: private static int schemeToCryptoMode(@Nullable String schemeType)
